command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/identity.test.ts
assertion: Rejects forged identity headers, stale assertions, wrong audiences, inactive bindings and unregistered operations.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/release-profile.test.ts
assertion: Requires one bounded configured upload library and rejects every deferred release profile.

command: corepack pnpm --filter portal exec vitest run app/routes/api.query.test.ts app/routes/health.test.ts app/modules/manual-workflow.test.tsx
assertion: The manual portal validates same-origin bounded queries, fails closed when unconfigured and exposes only the fixed manual workflow.

command: corepack pnpm --filter portal-worker exec vitest run src/manual-file.test.ts src/manual-processor.test.ts src/runtime.test.ts src/server.test.ts
assertion: Upload signatures, route capabilities, manual-source processing and provider-free runtime readiness fail closed.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/cache/cache.test.ts
assertion: Warm manual results are reauthorized and become unavailable after policy revocation or cache failure.
Forced RLS, membership revocation, source ACLs and runtime role separation hold in disposable PostgreSQL.
The read role cannot execute public business mutators and retains only the narrow identity resolver.
Manual queries require configured durable per-user and per-company admission limits.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/intake/manual-workflow.integration.test.ts
assertion: Capture, review, publish, authorized keyword retrieval, exact version access and tombstone non-resurrection work under real restricted roles.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/prompt-injection.test.ts
assertion: A document that asks for a tool or credential cannot change routing, add tools, alter capabilities or reach the model outside the untrusted-data frame.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/service-audience.test.ts
assertion: A service token or IAP assertion minted for another audience is refused by the production verification path.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/evidence-replay.test.ts
assertion: User evidence replayed by a different caller, for another company, after expiry or after binding revocation is refused.

command: corepack pnpm --filter portal exec vitest run app/routes/csrf.test.ts
assertion: Intake, removal, query and command mutations reject cross-site, missing and null origins before identity or any upstream call; downloads are gated on identity.

command: corepack pnpm --filter portal-worker exec vitest run src/fetch-policy.test.ts
assertion: Source fetching blocks metadata, loopback, private and rebinding targets, forbidden redirects, credentialed URLs, wrong content types and oversized bodies.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/query-exhaustion.test.ts
assertion: Retrieval bounds, contract limits, the in-flight computation cap and the request deadline refuse exhaustion instead of queueing it.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/hidden-results.test.ts
assertion: A hidden document that matches a search changes no counts, snippets, partial flags or evidence budget.
Under the real read role a matching hidden manual yields no rows, counts or version lookups.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/cache-poisoning.test.ts
assertion: Cache entries are actor, company, caller and policy scoped; planted or foreign-evidence envelopes are refused.

command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/security/citations.test.ts
assertion: Citations resolve only to versions the actor may read, and a version that becomes inaccessible before delivery aborts the answer.
